name: global-var-test-297b184697/oce_depend_on_global_variable-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed, but object constructor expressions are not listed.
Module-level declarations: "Class definition" supports "object-field", "method-defn" and "object-type-inclusion" members.
reason: The asserted behavior depends on a module-level anonymous object constructor expression (`object { ... }`) whose field initializer reads the global error-valued variable, followed by checking that the field remains an error rather than a string. Object constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list; support for class definitions and new expressions does not establish support for this anonymous constructor form.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous object constructor expression with a global-dependent field initializer and init method
test_design_notes: The retained io:println call is instrumentation only. The assertion helper's toString method is explicitly supported as value:toString.
